reconstruction_invariants: Owned rows of emitted packets followed by current snapshot equal r[0:n] exactly, once each.
Emitted packets at n form a prefix of emitted packets at m for n<=m; only final pending snapshot changes.
Each CLOSED_INTERVAL owns left sync plus strict interior and borrows right sync; no duplicated boundary ownership.
An emitted_at index equals the right boundary consumed by that step; no future row is used.
PREFIX emitted at first sync only if pending is nonempty; empty emitted packets excluded. No-sync and empty input yield only UNANCHORED snapshot.
Metadata/unknown rows participate in provenance ownership, never in physical timetag arithmetic unless documented.
emit/persist/passive_read never produce a second transition or append.
physical_decision_algorithm: Input is the enriched semantic interval_view, not the Python streaming machine. Malformed input returns STOP_INPUT retaining the request without fabricating Source/Context.
Validate interval_view.source/context/packet identity, bound bundle identity and externally admitted evidence receipts. Every physical decision retains the complete view, Source, Context and packet.
Require a complete interval and unique same-run physical trial/setting attribution. Supported invalidity gives INVALID_PHYSICAL_ATTEMPT; ambiguity or missing evidence gives STOP_PHYSICAL.

Require applicable clock, window, pointer, recording-coverage and activity evidence. Candidate completeness must prove that all relevant registrations for every declared physical window and admitted parameter belong to this packet's owned strict interior and the pinned inspected extent, using registration-latency and record-order bounds. Otherwise STOP; no implicit neighboring packets.

Only then classify supplied candidates by exact fixed-endpoint or joint-correlated-extrema rules. Preserve every definite-out, ambiguous, inactive or unmatched row and reason; no implicit denominator deletion.

Return a conditional zero/single/multiple registration result only if all limited-readout premises pass. Candidate completeness is required for all three. Never manufacture a quantum post-state or complete instrument.
Sort and deduplicate STOP reason IDs. The empty bundle always returns STOP_PHYSICAL retaining the complete interval view, Source, Context and packet.

clock_and_window.clock_family: T_s(q)=a_s*q+b_s on each independently certified validity segment; a_s>0.
clock_and_window.parameter_domain: A nonempty bounded rational polytope with explicit units, correlations, calibration sources and an external admission receipt.
clock_and_window.pps_association: A same-run certificate identifies a common physical second, the serial-calendar/PPS relation, latency/jitter and possible jumps. Calendar 64 and separate 00_03 files alone are insufficient.
clock_and_window.pairing_rule: Only unique certified physical trial labels on a common valid domain; unmatched and ambiguous packets remain visible.
clock_and_window.windows: Finite disjoint half-open intervals [L_j,U_j), relative to a certified trial reference, with explicit pulse indexing, grouping, setting association and units. Fixed-endpoint branch requires exact fixed rational L_j<U_j.
clock_and_window.row_relative_time: [A,B] are exact extrema of the row's relative time over the certificate uncertainty polytope. The A/B membership formulas below apply only to exact fixed L,U.
clock_and_window.definite_in: FIXED EXACT ENDPOINTS ONLY: A>=L and B<U
clock_and_window.definite_out: FIXED EXACT ENDPOINTS ONLY: B<L or A>=U
clock_and_window.otherwise: AMBIGUOUS -> STOP_PHYSICAL for that claimed classification
clock_and_window.multiple_pulses: Retain separate pulse indices and raw multiplicity; group only by a predeclared union.
forbidden_inferences: No exact 100 kHz equality from the filename.
No propagation delay from 18 feet without a velocity factor.
No hard 10 ns/100 ns bound from approximate narrative.
No calibration from the observed 129xxx spacing range.
No outcome-optimized clock, window, segment or pairing.
No cw45 radius without same-run timing metadata.

uncertain_endpoint_extension.domain: Affine t(theta), L(theta), U(theta) on the same nonempty bounded rational polytope P; all joint correlations retained; ordered disjoint windows certified throughout P.
uncertain_endpoint_extension.unsupported: STOP_PHYSICAL for unsupported endpoint dependence or missing joint bounds; do not substitute separate marginal ranges for the correlated differences.

candidate_completeness.requirement: For every admitted theta and declared W_j(theta), Reg(W_j,theta) is a subset of {RowRef(Source.stream_id,i): j_left<i<j_right and 0<=i<N_pinned}. Reg means all relevant recorded registrations attributed to that physical window under the certified registration model.
candidate_completeness.resolution: Every candidate reference resolves in the submitted packet's owned strict interior. Together with recording/loss evidence this excludes unaccounted relevant registrations outside the candidate set.
candidate_completeness.insufficient: Archival packet closure, consecutive transfer IDs, narrow observed sync spacing or absence of a row in the packet alone do not prove completeness.
candidate_completeness.failure: STOP_PHYSICAL when containment, order or latency is unresolved or the window may require registrations outside this owned interior/inspected extent.
candidate_completeness.neighboring_packets: Not consulted implicitly. Borrowed right sync does not supply neighboring interior. A multi-packet collector requires a separately specified ownership/coverage contract and inspection scope.
